questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: A new religion that bans meat
Why vegetarians are always healthier than people who eat meat
A diet of mainly plants and a little meat
How farmers are fighting climate change
questions.why: They discuss flexitarianism: mainly eating plant-based foods and only occasionally eating meat.

questions.q: How does Catherine first misunderstand the word 'flexitarian'?
options: She thinks it is a religion
She thinks it is a type of exercise
She thinks it is a kind of pepper
She thinks it is a political party
questions.why: She answers 'No, I'm not really religious', and Neil says 'It's not a religion!'

questions.q: According to the report, what are the benefits of being flexitarian?
options: It is cheaper and quicker to cook
It is healthier and helps fight climate change
It helps farmers earn more money
It is better for animals and also saves a lot of water
questions.why: Neil says it is healthier for the individual but can also help to fight climate change.

questions.q: What does Dr Marco Springmann say is needed to stay within environmental limits?
options: Only a change to plant-based diets
Stopping all farming of animals
Growing more food in cities
Several different changes together
questions.why: He says 'a combination of measures would be needed', including diet, technology, farming and less waste.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the changes Dr Springmann mentions?
options: Better technology
Wasting less food
Eating more fish
Changing farming methods
questions.why: He lists diets, technology, farming management and less food waste, but not eating fish.

questions.q: How much red meat does Dr Springmann say is probably OK?
options: One serving a day
None at all
Two or three small servings a week
No more than one serving a week
questions.why: He says you shouldn't have more than one serving of red meat per week.

questions.q: What does Springmann mean when he says to treat red meat as a luxury?
options: Eat it only as an occasional treat
Buy only the most expensive meat
Eat it only at restaurants
Replace it with lamb
questions.why: Catherine explains a luxury is something we eat as a treat, and red meat shouldn't be a regular part of our diet.

questions.q: How did the report's authors reach their advice?
options: They asked people what they liked to eat
They studied research that was already published
They tested the new diets on a large group of volunteers
They followed the advice of farmers
questions.why: Catherine says they surveyed the literature, studying research that had already been published.
